title: Credits Exhausted in 3 Days
review:
I purchased a monthly subscription and my included credits were completely exhausted within only 3 days of normal use.

Before purchasing, it was not made sufficiently clear that the included credits could realistically run out so quickly. A monthly subscription should provide reasonable usage throughout the month, not just a few days.

I contacted support and requested a detailed breakdown showing exactly how my 40,000 credits were consumed, but I have not received a satisfactory response.

What makes this even more frustrating is that the price of additional credits is extremely high compared to competing voice-changing services that offer significantly more value for the same cost.

Until the company provides transparent credit usage reports and improves customer support, I cannot recommend this app.

Buyers should be very careful before purchasing a subscription
author: Credits Exhausted in 3 Days
